atoms.text: Squirrels live in various habitats. They forage for nuts, seeds, and fruits, often scampering through trees with incredible speed and agility. Squirrels are resourceful creatures and stash away food in numerous hidden locations to prepare for harsher seasons. They build nests, called dreys, using twigs and leaves high up in trees, providing safety for their offspring. Squirrels are also social animals, sometimes playfully chasing or communicating vocally and through tail movements.

atoms.a:
Squirrels:
• Squirrels lead agile lives, foraging for nuts and fruits in trees.
• They stash food for harsh seasons, displaying foresight and preparation.
• Squirrels build safe nests (dreys) from twigs and leaves high in trees.
• They exhibit playful behaviours and communication through vocalisations and tail movements.

hint.text: Echolocation is used by some animals to navigate and detect objects. They can emit sound waves and interpret the echoes that bounce back.

atoms.text: Dolphins are highly intelligent and social creatures that inhabit oceans in tight-knit pods. Using whistles, clicks, and body language, they communicate and coordinate activities within their groups. Their playful nature often includes acrobatic displays, such as leaping and riding waves. With a diet mainly consisting of fish and squid, they employ echolocation for hunting. Their adaptability to diverse marine environments shows their resilience and importance in maintaining oceanic ecosystems.

atoms.text: Rabbits are agile animals that inhabit various environments. They spend their days foraging for grass, leaves and vegetables, with their diet being plant-based. Rabbits breed frequently, often creating elaborate burrows as their homes, known as warrens, where they raise their young. They have keen senses, using their large ears to detect potential threats. Despite their small size, rabbits adjust well to different climates.
